race.title: Restorations UK Berkshire National Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: OUR POWER confirmed that he still has lots to offer when only narrowly denied at Sandown to end last season and he remains 1 lb below his last winning mark. He can pick up where he left off to return to winning ways, though Rock My Way isn't taken lightly in his bid to land this prize for the second year running. Mt Fugi Park completes the shortlist. OUR POWER (IRE) ROCK MY WAY (IRE) MT FUGI PARK (IRE)
